name: Chroma Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source vector database for embeddings and similarity search, available as an embedded local store or self-hosted client/server; no vendor-imposed software vector or query quota.
watch_out: Self-hosted Chroma is distinct from metered Chroma Cloud with introductory $5 credits. You provide storage, backups, access controls, hosting and any external embedding-model/API costs; production scaling and security are your responsibility.
